title: Roivant's TYK2/JAK inhibitor reduces need for steroids in inflammatory eye disease
snippet: Brepocitinib is on a roll. After winning approval for an autoimmune skin disease, Roivant Sciences subsidiary Priovant’s drug hit all primary and secondary endpoints in a pair of Phase 3 non-infectious uveitis trials, leading analysts to say the candidate “looked superior to Humira.”

title: ESMO 2026: Merck’s Kelun-partnered ADC hits the ‘Goldilocks zone,’ VP says
snippet: At the European Society for Medical Oncology meeting this weekend, Merck will showcase three late-stage trials of its Kelun-Biotech–partnered TROP2-directed antibody sac-TMT that VP of Chemistry Alan Northrup says gets the payload release “just right.”

title: As H-1B visa changes keep coming, biopharmas adjust hiring approach
